title: Hexo post and page front matter
description: The front matter of a Markdown file under source/: a post in source/_posts/ or a page anywhere else. Hexo reads more keys than these; add one here when the site uses it.

author.description: The author shown on the page when it is not the site's author.

categories.description: The categories the post belongs to; the first one can appear in its address through permalink.

comments.description: false turns comments off for this page.

date.description: When the page was written, such as 2026-01-02 03:04:05; a post's date is part of its address.

description.description: One sentence about the page, for search results and link previews.

excerpt.description: A summary shown in lists instead of the start of the page.

image.description: The image shown in link previews: a path or URL.

keywords.description: Keywords for the keywords meta tag.

lang.description: The page language as a tag such as en or fa-IR, when it differs from the site's.

layout.description: The theme layout to use, such as page or post; false writes the page without a layout.

permalink.description: An address for this page that overrides the permalink pattern.

published.description: false keeps a post out of the build until it is published.

tags.description: The tags the post is listed under.

title.description: The page title, shown in the heading, the browser tab, and search results.

toc.description: false hides the table of contents the theme may add to this page.

updated.description: When the page last changed, such as 2026-01-02 03:04:05.
